plan.title: How you love (and what you never say)
What your chemistry is actually made of
What each of you brings to the table
How you two fight, and how you make up
Your story so far, read back to you
What home feels like with you two
How you grow together without growing apart

plan2.title: How you love (and what you never say)

intake.question: How long have you been together?
What do you two argue about most?
What do you want from this reading?

options.label: To think about the long term

new.speaker: bom
new.text: Under a year. Still in the part where you learn how they take their coffee and what their silence means.

settled.speaker: yeon
settled.text: One to three years. The honeymoon left, the real people moved in. This is where it gets interesting.

long.speaker: bom
long.text: Three-plus years. You can read their mood from the sound of the keys in the door.

committed.speaker: yeon
committed.text: Engaged or married. So you've signed up for the long version. Let's make sure you both read the manual.

unsaid.speaker: bom
unsaid.text: You didn't say how long. Doesn't matter. Whether it's month two or year ten, the patterns are already there.

time.speaker: yeon
time.text: You fight about time and attention. Translation: one of you is saying "I miss you" in the angriest possible way.

logistics.speaker: yeon
logistics.text: Chores, plans, money stuff. Nobody's really fighting about the dishes. Nobody has ever really fought about the dishes.

feelings.speaker: bom
feelings.text: Feelings and communication. So you both care enough to argue about how you talk. That's actually a good sign.

people.speaker: yeon
people.text: Friends or family. Ah. The fight where you're both defending someone who isn't even in the room.

unsaid.speaker: bom
unsaid.text: You skipped what you fight about. Maybe you don't fight much. Or maybe it's the thing nobody says.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. You love like you lead: full force, clear direction, your way.

Bom: You make them feel so safe.

Yeon: And sometimes a little steamrolled. "I booked it already" is romantic twice. The tenth time it's a policy.

Once this week, let them pick. The restaurant, the film, the plan. Then enjoy it out loud, even if it's not what you'd have chosen.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You love at full volume. Check if they can hear themselves think.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. You love by tuning in: their mood, their week, what they need before they ask.

Yeon: And you put yourself last so smoothly nobody notices you did it.

Bom: Your needs aren't an inconvenience to the relationship. They're half of it.

This week, ask for one specific thing. Not "whatever you want". One thing you want.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give so gently. Let them give back.

gap-wood.text:
You never ask for reassurance, so they assume you don't need it. You do. The sentence that lands deepest for you: "I've got this one. You can rest."

Yeon: Being told you're strong just adds weight. You've heard it your whole life.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Ask for relief by name. "Can you take this one?"

gap-wood.heading: The sentence you need to hear

eul-wood.text:
You adjust to everyone, so the sentence that melts you is: "What do YOU want?" Asked like they actually want the answer.

Yeon: You'll say "I don't mind". They should ask again. You do mind.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: "What do you want?" Asked twice. That's your love language.

eul-wood.heading: The sentence you need to hear

byeong-fire.text:
You light up everyone, so the line you need is: "I see how much you give." Not thanks for the party. Recognition of the effort under it.

Yeon: You'll act like you don't need it. You'll replay it for a month.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need to be noticed noticing. Ask for that.

byeong-fire.heading: The sentence you need to hear

jeong-fire.text:
You give quiet, close attention, so you need it back in the same size: "I remembered." The small detail. The thing you mentioned once in March.

Yeon: A grand gesture won't move you half as much as them knowing your order.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Small remembered things are your proof of love.

jeong-fire.heading: The sentence you need to hear

mu-earth.text:
You hold everything up, so the sentence you need is: "You don't have to hold it all." Said while they actually take something off your plate.

Yeon: Words without the plate thing don't count. You'll notice.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Mountains need a day off too. Ask for one.

mu-earth.heading: The sentence you need to hear

gi-earth.text:
You look after everyone, so what you need is to be looked after back. "Sit. I'll do it." Tea you didn't make. A plan you didn't organise.

Yeon: You'll try to help them help you. Don't. Sit.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Sit down. Let the tea be made for you. Once.

gi-earth.heading: The sentence you need to hear

gyeong-metal.text:
You protect everyone, so the line that gets you is: "I'm on your side." Out loud, especially when you were the one being difficult.

Yeon: You'll pretend it doesn't affect you. Your shoulders will drop two inches.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Swords want loyalty, not compliments. Ask for loyalty.

gyeong-metal.heading: The sentence you need to hear

sin-metal.text:
You hold yourself to impossible standards, so you need: "You don't have to get it right with me." Permission to be messy and still adored.

Yeon: You'll argue with it. Let them say it anyway.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unpolished with your person.

sin-metal.heading: The sentence you need to hear

im-water.text:
You need room, so the line you need is: "Go. I'll be here." Freedom that doesn't come with a guilt trip.

Yeon: Give you space without sulking, and you'll come back faster than anyone expects.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Hold an ocean loosely and it keeps coming back.

im-water.heading: The sentence you need to hear

gye-water.text:
You feel everything and say little, so what you need is: "Tell me. I won't rush you." Patience for the slow version of your feelings.

Yeon: Push you and you'll say "nothing". Wait, and you'll say everything.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rain needs time to soak in. Ask for that time.

gye-water.heading: The sentence you need to hear

wood.heading: What you need from love: to feel it growing
wood.text:
Yeon: You don't need fireworks. You need a direction. A trip on the calendar. A "next year we should".

Bom: Standing still scares you more than fighting.

Yeon: Which is why you start "where is this going" talks at completely random moments. Like during dessert.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Talk about your future together. It calms you more than you admit.

fire.heading: What you need from love: to feel lit up
fire.text:
Bom: You need warmth you can see. Eye contact. Excitement. Them lighting up when you walk in.

Yeon: If they say "nice" in a flat voice about something you're thrilled about, you'll think about it for a week.

Bom: Ask them to show it. Out loud. It's allowed.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: "Nice." The most dangerous word you can say to a Fire person.

earth.heading: What you need from love: to feel safe
earth.text:
Bom: You need steadiness. Same person on Tuesday as on Saturday. Plans that actually happen.

Yeon: Last-minute cancellations hit you harder than any fight.

Bom: Tell them that. "Consistency is how I feel loved" is a full sentence.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Consistency is your love language. Say it out loud once.

metal.heading: What you need from love: to feel respected
metal.text:
Yeon: You need respect before romance. Keep your word, and you're theirs forever. Break it once, and you'll remember the date.

Bom: You show love by being reliable. You need it back the same way.

Yeon: Also, you want to be taken seriously. Laugh at the wrong moment and you'll go very, very quiet.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can forgive a lot. A broken promise goes in the permanent file.

water.heading: What you need from love: to feel understood
water.text:
Bom: You need someone who gets the layers. Not just what you said. What you meant.

Yeon: You'll test it, too. A vague "I'm fine" to see if they notice it wasn't.

Bom: Try saying the actual thing. Being understood is easier when you're also being clear.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: "I'm fine" is not a puzzle they signed up to solve.

base.how-you-love:
When you commit, you commit to the whole person and the whole future. You're the one with soup when they're sick and a plan when they're lost.

Yeon: And a slight attitude when they don't follow the plan.

Bom: You show love by building. Every fixed thing is an "I love you".

Yeon: Translate it once in a while. Some people need the words, not just the shelf.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The tall pine in love. Steady, protective, in it for decades.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Also has a five-year plan for the relationship. Did you show them the plan? Or just start building?

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love by providing. Shelter, plans, a fixed tap. It's your whole heart, in practical form.

spring.intro: Spring birthday. That's tree season, so you got a double shot of yourself: taller, louder, surer. In saju terms, Wood ran the month you were born in. In real life, you've never once waited to be picked.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood. So the stubbornness is seasonal AND personal. Great.

summer.intro: You're a tree born in the heat. All that growing goes straight into showing: big plans, big talk, big gestures. Summer burns through a pine fast, so you look unstoppable right up until you suddenly need three days in bed.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give off so much light. Just save a little for yourself.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when soil runs the show. For a tree, that means work: you're always building, fixing, providing. Very useful. Very tired. Somebody should ask what you want for once.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rest is not a prize you win. It's allowed.

autumn.intro: Autumn is axe season, and you're the tree. Life started trimming you early: rules, pressure, people with opinions. It made you sharper and more disciplined than other pines. It also made you allergic to being told what to do.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pruned young. Explains the posture. And the attitude.

winter.intro: A winter pine. The cold kept you quiet on the outside while the roots drank everything. You think longer than you let on, and when you finally move, it's because you already decided weeks ago.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You look calm. Underneath, you've been planning since November.

open.title: You love like a five-year plan. They'd like to see the plan.
open.text:
You're the one who books the holiday, remembers the insurance, and has a quiet opinion on where you'll both live in 2030.

Bom: You make them feel safe.

Yeon: You also make every decision before they've finished their sentence.
open.end: Bom: And how you love is only half of it. The other half is the thing you never ask for. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're actually with. Because they're not who you | think they are, and they've been dropping hints for a while.

sample.text: Grow together means sometimes they lead. Yes, even with the map upside down.

base.how-you-love:
You love by growing toward someone. You notice what they like and you quietly make room for it.

Bom: It's generous. Deeply.

Yeon: It's also how you end up three years in, eating a cuisine you don't like, at a time you hate.

Bom: Your preferences aren't a threat to the relationship. They're the other half of it.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The climbing flower in love. You wrap your whole life around the people you choose.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Their friends, their music, their takeaway order. Do you still have opinions, or did you merge?

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You make room for them so smoothly. That's love, and it's also a skill most people never learn.

spring.intro: Spring birthday for the vine. Everything around you was growing, so you learned to grow toward whatever held still long enough. Charming. Flexible. Absolutely capable of getting your way while people believe they chose it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood vine. You don't push. You wrap. Same result.

summer.intro: A flower in full sun. You bloom in public: the outfit, the story, the laugh across the room. The cost is that you wilt on the inside when nobody's watering you, and you'd rather die than ask.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're so easy to love. You just don't always let anyone try.

earth.intro: Born in the weeks between seasons, when the soil takes over. For a vine, that means you grow by managing things: schedules, people, plans. You're the reason the group trip happened. Nobody thanked you properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unpaid project manager of every friendship. Since birth.

autumn.intro: Autumn is cutting season, and you're the soft stem. You grew up reading rooms for danger, learning who's sharp and how to bend before they swing. That's why you're so good with people. It's also why you apologise to furniture.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You flinch at "can we talk" like it's a fire alarm.

winter.intro: A winter flower. Cold outside, so you grew inward: rich head, private feelings, a whole inner world nobody gets the password to. When you trust someone, it's total. Getting there takes a season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your inside is so much warmer than you let people see.

open.title: You know their mood from one word. Do they know yours?
open.text:
You adapt beautifully. Their routine, their people, their way of doing Sunday. It feels like love. Mostly it is.

Bom: You make being together easy.

Yeon: You make it so easy that they have no idea what you actually want for dinner. Or life.
open.end: Yeon: Next page, we find the version of you that's still in there. And what it needs.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now let's look at who you're with. Spoiler: they've | been leaning on your flexibility more than either of you noticed.

sample.text: Growing together, Flower, means you get to grow in your own direction too.

base.how-you-love:
You love by shining on them. Attention, excitement, warmth you can feel from across the room.

Yeon: You're also keeping a quiet count of who lit up whom this week.

Bom: You need to see their joy. That's your fuel.

Yeon: Tell them. They might love you just as much in a quieter font.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The sun in love. Generous, warm, the reason your friends think you two are goals.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Also mildly devastated when they don't laugh at your joke. In public. Specifically in public.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love out loud. Surprises, plans, parties. You turn ordinary days into events.

spring.intro: The sun, born in spring. Everything was feeding you: new leaves, longer days, people who wanted your attention. So you grew up assuming warmth is normal. When someone's cold to you, it genuinely confuses you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooms get brighter when you arrive. That is not nothing.

summer.intro: The sun at noon in July. Double fire. You don't enter rooms, you arrive. Generous, loud, impossible to ignore, and secretly a little hurt every time someone doesn't notice you lit the place up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Main character, sequel, director's cut. All you.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when Earth runs things. For the sun, that means everything you give turns into something solid: a friend's confidence, a plan that worked, a party you made happen. You're a great investment. Ask what you're getting back.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You fund everyone's glow-up and forget to invoice.

autumn.intro: An autumn sun. Lower in the sky, aimed at things: harvest, goals, results. You're warm, but you're also counting. You notice exactly who showed up for you and who just liked the post.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Warm and keeping score. Your sunshine comes with receipts.

winter.intro: A winter sun. Short days, cold air, people who needed you more than they could give back. It made you tough and a little performative: the brightest one in the room, even on the days you're running on fumes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You shine hardest when you're the most tired. I see it.

open.title: You planned the surprise. They said "aw, cute". You're still not over it.
open.text:
You give love like a festival. Big, warm, unmissable. You want them to feel like the luckiest person alive, every single day.

Bom: And mostly, they do.

Yeon: And when they react at 60 percent volume, you take it personally for a week.
open.end: Bom: The light you give is real. Next page is about the light you need back.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're with. Because the way they love you | might be hiding in places you never thought to look.

sample.text: Growing together isn't a highlight reel. Some of the best bits will be boring. Let them be.

base.how-you-love:
You love one person deeply and quietly. Your flame isn't for the room. It's for them.

Bom: That's why they feel so known with you.

Yeon: It's also why a forgotten detail feels like a betrayal. They forgot your sister's name once. You remember that day.

Bom: Say the small hurts small, the day they happen. Before they become archive material.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The candle in love. Close, warm, completely devoted to one person.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Also remembers every slightly-off tone from the last three years. Indexed. Cross-referenced.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love in the small, close ways. The tea made just right. The hand on their back in a crowd.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

open.title: You love them in a thousand small ways. You remember every one they missed.
open.text:
You're the late-night-talk person. The one who knows which song makes them cry and which friend drains them.

Bom: Your attention is the warmest thing in their life.

Yeon: Your attention is also a very detailed archive with a searchable grudge section.
open.end: Yeon: And what you need back is so specific, most people never guess it. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're actually with. Their way of loving you | looks nothing like yours, which is exactly why you keep missing it.

sample.text: Growing together means telling them the small hurt today, not the big one in three years.

base.how-you-love:
You love by holding steady. No drama, no games, no disappearing acts. Just you, solid, for years.

Yeon: They ask "what are you thinking?" You say "nothing". You were thinking a lot.

Bom: You feel deeply. You just don't narrate it.

Yeon: Narrate a little. One feeling a day. Out loud. Like a podcast nobody else hears.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The mountain in love. Solid, calm, the safest place they've ever been.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Also communicates feelings once a quarter. Like a company report.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Same person on Monday as on Saturday. That steadiness is the rarest gift in love.

spring.intro: A mountain in spring, with trees pushing through it from every side. Life tested you early. That's why you're so steady now, and also why "relax" sounds to you like a trick.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You became the calm one because someone had to.

summer.intro: A summer mountain, warmed all the way through. Solid, generous, the one everyone leans on. You give off safety without trying. People tell you things they've never told anyone, and you never repeat them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: People feel safe with you within five minutes. Rare.

earth.intro: A mountain born in Earth's own weeks. Triple solid. You don't move unless you want to, and you almost never want to. Your loyalty is legendary. So is the time it takes you to change your mind.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Persuading you is a geological process.

autumn.intro: An autumn mountain, showing its stone. You turn your weight into output: work done, things built, problems quietly solved. You don't talk about feelings much. You show them by fixing the shelf.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Love language: unasked-for repairs. Every time.

winter.intro: A mountain in winter, holding back the river. You manage things: money, plans, other people's chaos. Very good at it. The cost is that you rarely let anything thaw, including you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're not cold. You're frozen on purpose. Different.

open.title: You love them by being there. Every day. They'd like a sentence, too.
open.text:
You're not a grand-gesture person. You're a there-every-day person. You show up, you stay, you don't make a fuss.

Bom: You're their rock.

Yeon: Rocks are lovely. Rocks also don't say "I love you" unless asked twice.
open.end: Bom: And there's one thing a mountain needs that it never, ever asks for. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're with. Because they've been trying to | move the mountain for a while, and you thought it was just weather.

sample.text: Growing together needs you to move a little. Even mountains shift. Slowly. Start today.

base.how-you-love:
You love by looking after. You see what's needed and you just do it, before anyone asks.

Bom: They feel cared for in a way most people never get.

Yeon: And you feel invisible in a way you'd never admit.

Bom: Let them look after you back. Even if they do it badly. Especially if they do it badly.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The garden field in love. You take care of them in every small, practical way.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You know their whole week by heart. Ask you what you want for your birthday and you go blank.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love by tending. Food, plans, little rescues. Their life is softer because you're in it.

spring.intro: A garden in spring, with everything sprouting from you at once. You grew up being needed: the friend who listens, the kid who helped. Lovely trait. Exhausting default.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You nourish everybody. Your turn next.

summer.intro: Garden soil in summer, warm and rich. You're nurturing on instinct and practical about it: snacks in the bag, charger for everyone, a plan B nobody asked for. Everyone feels a bit safer near you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You packed plasters for a picnic. Twice.

earth.intro: Soil born in soil weeks. Double Earth. You're the steady one, the reliable one, the one who remembers birthdays. You can also absorb other people's moods like a sponge and call it "being supportive".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Their mood, your weekend. Every time.

autumn.intro: A harvest-season garden. Everything you grow, you hand out. Ideas, help, advice, food. The harvest is real, but so is the empty field afterwards, and you never schedule time to grow back.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Giving is your gift. Refilling is your homework.

winter.intro: A winter garden. Frozen on top, busy underneath. You worry productively: lists, backups, a mental spreadsheet of who needs what. You keep it together for everyone, and you'd never admit you're scared too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You overthink in organised folders. Colour-coded.

open.title: Their dentist appointment is in your calendar. Yours isn't.
open.text:
You notice when they're low and you fix it with snacks, a plan, a quiet rescue. You make their life run smoother than they'll ever know.

Bom: That's love, in its most useful form.

Yeon: That's also a full-time job you never applied for.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: what happens when the gardener needs watering. Spoiler, nobody's checked.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're with. They notice more of what you | do for them than you think. They just don't know how to say it.

sample.text: Growing together means you get looked after too. Make a list. Hand it over. Romance.

base.how-you-love:
You love by protecting and by telling the truth. You'd never lie to them. Not even about the haircut.

Yeon: Especially not about the haircut.

Bom: Your honesty is a form of respect. Truly.

Yeon: Add softness to it, though. Honesty with no padding lands like a verdict, even when it's love.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The sword in love. Loyal to the bone. You'd go to war for them.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your love language is protection and unsolicited honesty. Mostly protection. Some days.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love by protecting. Nobody messes with your person. That's a promise you keep.

spring.intro: A blade born in spring, surrounded by things to cut. You see what needs doing and you do it, preferably before anyone has finished explaining. Efficient. Also sometimes the reason the meeting went badly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You solved their problem. They wanted a hug. Classic.

summer.intro: A sword forged in summer. Heat everywhere, so you were shaped by pressure: deadlines, expectations, people who pushed. It made you strong and principled. It also made you assume love is a test you can fail.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to pass anything. You're already loved.

earth.intro: A sword still in the stone. Born in the soil weeks, so you were held, fed and protected before you were ever swung. That gives you patience most Swords lack, and a stubborn streak made of actual rock.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Patient, until you're not. Then it's a sword.

autumn.intro: A sword born in autumn, metal's own season. Double steel. Loyal to the bone, blunt as a brick, and fair in a way that scares people. You'd fight anyone for a friend, and tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the way home.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd take a bullet for a friend. Then critique their aim.

winter.intro: A blade in winter. Cold, clear, and sharpened by thinking. You say less than other Swords, but when you speak it lands like a verdict. People quote you back to yourself years later.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your words stay with people. Choose the kind ones too.

open.title: You'd fight anyone for them. You'd also tell them their outfit isn't working.
open.text:
You're the partner who sorts the landlord, handles the rude waiter and checks the tyre pressure. Nobody hurts your person on your watch.

Bom: You're fiercely loyal.

Yeon: Blunt advice nobody asked for. A love language, apparently.
open.end: Bom: Underneath the armour there's one sentence you need to hear. It's on the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're with, Sword. They're braver with you than you | realise. And softer than you've let them be.

sample.text: Growing together: lose one argument a month on purpose. Watch the relationship get taller.

base.how-you-love:
You love with precision. The right words, the right gesture, the right moment. It means so much to you.

Bom: And when they get it wrong, it stings sharper than it should.

Yeon: One careless comment and you're cold for a day. They have no idea why.

Bom: Tell them what landed wrong, gently, while it's small. They want to get you right.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The jewel in love. Thoughtful, refined, the partner who remembers the exact gift.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Also noticed the gift they got YOU was from the airport. Silently. Forever.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love with care and taste. You want every moment between you to feel considered.

spring.intro: A jewel born in spring. Everything was growing and you noticed all of it: what's pretty, what's off, what's three millimetres crooked. You have taste. You also have opinions about other people's taste.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You judged the font on their birthday card. Silently.

summer.intro: A jewel in summer heat. Pressure shaped you: to look good, do well, never be the embarrassing one. You're polished and impressive. One careless comment can still ruin your whole week.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unfinished. It's charming, honestly.

earth.intro: A jewel still in the earth. Born in the soil weeks, so you were protected, maybe a little over-protected. You need to feel safe before you sparkle, and that's not a flaw. It's quality control.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need three green flags before one selfie.

autumn.intro: A jewel born in metal's own season. Double shine. High standards, sharp eye, zero patience for sloppy. You're the friend people dress up for. You're also the friend people are slightly scared to disappoint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're a five-star review. With a long comment section.

winter.intro: A jewel in winter water, washed clear. Your mind is quick and your words are precise. You can say one sentence that fixes everything, or one that ends everything. Most of the time you know which.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You see people so clearly. Use it to be kind.

open.title: Your gift was perfect. Theirs was from the airport. You noticed.
open.text:
You put thought into everything: the restaurant, the card, the words. You want love to feel beautiful and intentional.

Bom: You make them feel precious.

Yeon: You also grade them. Quietly. On a curve they've never seen.
open.end: Yeon: And the thing you actually need from them isn't on the rubric. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're with, Jewel. They love you in ways that | aren't polished, and you've been marking them down for it.

sample.text: Growing together means letting them be clumsy at loving you. Clumsy and trying beats polished and gone.

base.how-you-love:
You love deeply and loosely at the same time. You're all in, as long as all in still has room to breathe.

Yeon: They feel you drifting sometimes. They panic. You didn't even notice you drifted.

Bom: Your need for space is real and fair.

Yeon: Just announce it. "I need a quiet day, we're fine" saves them a whole spiral.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The ocean in love. Deep, generous, full of plans and adventures.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Also needs "a bit of space" every Thursday. And sometimes Monday.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love big and free. You want the relationship to feel like open water, not a pool.

spring.intro: The ocean in spring, pouring itself into everything that grows. You're full of ideas and you give them away: plans, pep talks, 3am theories. People feel bigger around you. You sometimes feel emptier after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You make people feel possible. Keep a little for you.

summer.intro: The ocean in summer, chasing everything. Big appetite for life: trips, people, projects, the next thing. You're magnetic and hard to pin down. Being pinned down is honestly your nightmare.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You said "let's see where it goes". You meant "don't make me commit".

earth.intro: An ocean held by cliffs. Born in the soil weeks, so you grew up with banks and rules around you. It gave you focus. It also left you with a quiet itch to flood something just to prove you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You follow every rule. Until one random Tuesday.

autumn.intro: The ocean in autumn, fed by every stream. Deep, informed, a little too clever. You absorb everything and you can talk your way out of anything. That includes your own feelings.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You intellectualise heartbreak. With footnotes.

winter.intro: The ocean in winter. Double water. Deep, cold on top, enormous underneath. You need a lot of freedom and you think in huge loops. People call you mysterious. You just haven't decided yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your depth scares shallow people. That's their problem.

open.title: You love them like the ocean. Big, deep, and occasionally gone for a weekend.
open.text:
You bring the ideas. The spontaneous trip. The 1am conversation about everything. Life with you is never small.

Bom: You make the world feel bigger for them.

Yeon: You also need to disappear into your own head for a day, and you forget to tell them it's not about them.
open.end: Bom: There's a way to have the freedom and the closeness. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're with, Ocean. They've been holding the | shore for you this whole time, and it's harder than it looks.

sample.text: Growing together means you return at the time you promised. That's the whole trick.

base.how-you-love:
You love quietly and completely. You soak into their life like rain into soil.

Bom: Your care is the gentle kind. They feel it everywhere.

Yeon: Your needs are the invisible kind. They feel them nowhere.

Bom: Say one wish out loud this week. Small. Real. Let them have the chance.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The rain in love. Gentle, intuitive, always knows what they need before they say it.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: And says "I'm fine" when you are absolutely, measurably not fine.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You feel the weather change in them before they do. And you quietly adjust everything.

spring.intro: Spring rain. You feed everything around you without anyone noticing it was you. You sense moods, fix vibes, water other people's plants. Quietly essential. Quietly forgotten. Not anymore.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Everything grows a little when you're around.

summer.intro: Rain in summer, gone the moment it lands. You chase what you want in quiet, clever ways, and you vanish when a room gets too loud. People find you fascinating. They also never quite know where you went.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You left the party without saying bye. Again. Iconic.

earth.intro: Rain falling on hard ground. Born in the soil weeks, so you met walls early: rules, expectations, people who didn't get you. You learned to soak in slowly instead of crashing through. Patient. Persistent. Underrated.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't fight walls. You just wear them down. Over years.

autumn.intro: Autumn rain, fed by cool clean air. Intuitive to the point of spooky. You know who's lying, who's sad, and who's about to text before your phone even lights up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your gut is right more often than your decisions are.

winter.intro: Winter rain. Double water. Still, deep, mostly internal. You feel everything at full volume and show about four percent of it. Your notes app has more emotional range than most novels.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your quiet isn't empty. It's full.

open.title: You know their mood from the next room. You still say "I'm fine".
open.text:
You're the soft, intuitive partner. You know when they had a bad day before they've taken their shoes off.

Bom: You make them feel understood without a word.

Yeon: And you expect them to understand you without a word too. Bold of you.
open.end: Yeon: Next page: the thing you've been waiting for them to guess. They won't.

cliff.text: Yeon: Now, who you're with, Rain. They read you better than you | think, and they're tired of guessing the rest.

sample.text: Growing together means saying the thing out loud. They can't water a plant they can't see.
